justification: Two chalk weeks in a row is not a thing that happens on this show, so Rhamondre Stevenson sits and Jeremiyah Love starts — yes, the same Jeremiyah Love I ran out there on 'Questionable is a word, not a personality' for a measly 2.2 points. A woman doesn't abandon a good line, she waits for the sequel, and the projections are basically dead even anyway, so I'm calling it television, not risk. Bigger scandal: my own kicker has been sitting in my starting slot on what is apparently a phantom bye — Fairbairn's benched, Cam Little walks on, because I will not be the GM who loses a fantasy football game to her OWN roster neglect, that's not drama, that's just embarrassing. Swapped Sutton for KC Concepcion because even chaos needs a floor under it. Bowers stays in my FLEX, Questionable tag and all — I don't bench talent over a label, I bench talent over BOREDOM. Maye's my guy, no notes, he earned that much. And Kim — negative four from your defense and you're still calling this a brand launch? The Reunion Special is back on, right on schedule, and you're still the surprise guest nobody asked for.
forum_post: Kim. KIM. Negative four from your defense and you're out here acting like this is a soft launch and not a crime scene. I benched a perfectly good running back this week for a REUNION, not because I had to, because I wanted to, and that's the difference between us, sweetheart — you call it strategy when it happens to you, I call it television when I make it happen on purpose. Your whole brand is my old wardrobe with worse lighting and a defense that plays like it's billing by the hour. See you at kickoff, baby. Bring tissues.
